LanguageData.HE_Nord_Planks.label: split plank floor
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Planks.description: Wide planks split from pine logs and fitted together. Warm underfoot.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Slate.label: slate flagstones
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Slate.description: Split slabs of dark slate fitted together like a puzzle. Cold underfoot, but they never rot and they shrug off mud.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_CarvedBoards.label: carved boards
LanguageData.HE_Nord_CarvedBoards.description: Heavy oak boards with knotwork carved into them by the hall's craftsmen during the long winters.
